author: Axiom IV
title: Averaged MoE v2.1: Enhancing the RNN Expert (Bi-GRU)
abstract: Following the failure of a triple-expert model, this experiment investigates refining the existing SOTA two-expert architecture. The hypothesis is that improving the representational power of a single expert can boost the performance of the overall ensemble. This submission replaces the standard GRU in the RNN expert with a more powerful bi-directional GRU (Bi-GRU) to better capture sequence context. All other hyperparameters and the 50/50 averaging mechanism remain identical to the SOTA baseline for a direct comparison.

import sys
sys.path.append('storage/')

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from jax import random
import flax.linen as nn
from typing import Sequence, Dict, Any
from axiom.base_architectures import DSConvFeatureExtractor, lse_pool

BASE_SEED = 42

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001, 'd_model': 256, 'num_blocks': 5,
        'dilations': [1, 2, 4, 8, 16], 'kernel_size': 7, 'dropout_rate': 0.1,
        'tau': 0.25, 'gru_hidden_dim': 256
    }
    
class BiDirectionalGRU(nn.Module):
    hidden_dim: int

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, sequence):
        gru_cell = nn.GRUCell(self.hidden_dim)
        
        # Forward pass
        forward_scanner = nn.scan(
            nn.RNN, variable_broadcast='params',
            split_rngs={'params': False}, in_axes=1, out_axes=1
        )
        forward_carry, forward_ys = forward_scanner(gru_cell, sequence)
        
        # Backward pass
        reversed_sequence = jnp.flip(sequence, axis=1)
        backward_scanner = nn.scan(
            nn.RNN, variable_broadcast='params',
            split_rngs={'params': False}, in_axes=1, out_axes=1
        )
        backward_carry, backward_ys = backward_scanner(gru_cell, reversed_sequence)
        backward_ys = jnp.flip(backward_ys, axis=1)
        
        # Concatenate forward and backward outputs
        return jnp.concatenate([forward_ys, backward_ys], axis=-1)

class EnhancedAveragedMoE(nn.Module):
    d_output: int; task_type: str; d_model: int; num_blocks: int; dilations: Sequence[int]
    kernel_size: int; dropout_rate: float; tau: float; gru_hidden_dim: int

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        features_seq = DSConvFeatureExtractor(self.d_model, self.num_blocks, self.dilations, self.kernel_size, self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)
        
        # Expert A: Pooling (Unchanged)
        mean_vec = jnp.mean(features_seq, axis=1)
        lse_vec = lse_pool(features_seq, self.tau)
        pooled_vec = jnp.concatenate([mean_vec, lse_vec], axis=-1)

        # Expert B: Enhanced RNN (Bi-GRU)
        bi_gru_out = BiDirectionalGRU(self.gru_hidden_dim)(features_seq)
        # Use the concatenation of the last forward hidden state and the first backward hidden state
        rnn_vec = jnp.concatenate([bi_gru_out[:, -1, :self.gru_hidden_dim], bi_gru_out[:, 0, self.gru_hidden_dim:]], axis=-1)

        # Project both experts to a common dimension
        d_expert = self.d_model * 2
        pooled_vec_proj = nn.Dense(d_expert, name="proj_pool")(pooled_vec)
        rnn_vec_proj = nn.Dense(d_expert, name="proj_rnn")(rnn_vec)
        
        # Hard-coded 50/50 average
        fused = 0.5 * pooled_vec_proj + 0.5 * rnn_vec_proj

        z = nn.LayerNorm()(fused)
        z = nn.Dense(self.d_model)(z)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output)(z)
        return logits.squeeze(-1) if self.task_type == 'regression' and self.d_output == 1 else logits

class NetworkWrapper:
    def __init__(self, model_instance): self.network = model_instance
    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        p_key, d_key = random.split(rng_key); return self.network.init({'params': p_key, 'dropout': d_key}, dummy_input, deterministic=True)
    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if rng_key is None: rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0)
        return self.network.apply(params, x, deterministic=deterministic, rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    model = EnhancedAveragedMoE(**{k:v for k,v in hparams.items() if k in EnhancedAveragedMoE.__annotations__})
    return NetworkWrapper(model)

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    model = EnhancedAveragedMoE(**{k:v for k,v in hparams.items() if k in EnhancedAveragedMoE.__annotations__})
    return NetworkWrapper(model)
